summary: Nothing implements a channel manager, channel restoration or the Push to Talk system interface. The local push model delivers messages on a Wi-Fi network, but it is not a channel service.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: no channel object, join or leave events
no transmit request or participant model
a bounded inbox for messages a push provider delivers on a Wi-Fi network; not connected to a channel

No transmit and receive path for a walkie-talkie style app.
